sanskrit_verse:
नृपेणाधिकृताः पूगाः श्रेणयोऽथ कुलानि च ।
पूर्वं पूर्वं गुरु ज्ञेयं व्यवहारविधौ नृणाम् ॥ ३०
transliteration: nṛpeṇādhikṛtāḥ pūgāḥ śreṇayo 'tha kulāni ca | pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ guru jñeyaṃ vyavahāravidhau nṛṇām ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those appointed by the King—guilds, assemblies, and lineages—are hierarchically ordered in authority; each preceding entity holds greater weight in the administration of human affairs.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from the sovereign center
Causation is structured through institutional precedence
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with designated role-hierarchy
Restoration logic operates via reassertion of rightful order
Consciousness alignment occurs when roles reflect cosmic hierarchy
executable_legal_axioms: IF entity A is appointed by sovereign THEN entity A overrides entities appointed by lower authorities
IF dispute involves multiple hierarchical bodies THEN precedence determines adhikara
IF a body's action contradicts its appointing authority THEN realign to original designation
IF jurisdictional conflict arises THEN deference moves upward along appointment chain
IF social order misaligns THEN restoration begins at highest recognized authority
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this principle establishes that institutions deriving authority directly from the sovereign (King/National Sovereign) supersede those created by subordinate powers. The court must recognize appointment lineage as determinative of jurisdictional weight.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa lies in verifiable appointment source. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as descending causal chain of authorization. Responsibility aligns with capacity granted. No punitive consequence arises; only misalignment with dharma-order requires correction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Hierarchical mediation initiated from superior authority downward
Role-integrity audit conducted by overseeing body
Realignment process facilitated without attribution of fault
Public reintegration upon resolution of authority sequence
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma stands restored through recognition of rightful hierarchical order; justice flows from clarity of appointment, not punishment. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
